sources.note: official, 328 GB; a 1–2-bit GGUF (e.g. unsloth) would be needed

runtimes.value: llama.cpp llama-server with GGUF (ggml-org, arch glm5-next; Q2_K_S 110 GB, Q2_K 134 GB, MTP sidecar, vision mmproj Q8_0); DwarfStar (lists GLM 5.3 Flash, 96 GB+, --mtp); MLX builds (mlx-community 4bit, pipenetwork 4/6/8-bit; too large at 4-bit for 128 GB). Ollama: cloud tag only
runtimes.note: Only Q2_K_S (110 GB) is plausible on 128 GB; leaves little room for context. LM Studio not checked (no lmstudio-community repo found). mlx-lm support inferred from the mlx-community conversion, not tested.

fits_128gb.note: official weights 328 GB; the smallest GGUF (Q2_K_S, 110 GB) leaves almost no room for context

web.scope: Searched on 13.11.2026: Hacker News comments only (Algolia API). Reddit, Hugging Face discussions and runtime issues not read yet.
web.summary: Well regarded as an API model, close to Sonnet for some users. Locally it only fits on 128 GB at 1–2 bits, with less margin than DeepSeek V4-Flash. Thin local feedback.
web.verdict: Close to Sonnet as an API model; locally 93–109 GB, tighter than DeepSeek; thin local feedback

comments.text: Compared with GLM-5.3/flash, Sonnet seems lazier but follows prompts better ([disgruntledphd2, 12.11.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50468259)).
Flash models such as GLM 5.3 Flash and DS 4.1 Flash 1017 judged very good, very fast and very cheap ([rheisen_, 12.11.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50470173)).
Little difference found between Sonnet and GLM-5.3/flash ([disgruntledphd2, 12.11.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50468259)).
Used together with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash for cross-validation ([joehuangsweden, 13.11.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50476424)).
Listed with DeepSeek V4 Flash among the large MoE models for 128 GB machines: 320B parameters, 18B active ([Tepix, 26.08.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49454403)).
